import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors1 = plt.cm.viridis(range(0, 256, 25))[:10]
bars1 = ax1.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values, color=colors1)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(top_breeds.index)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Registration by District (Kreis)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors2 = plt.cm.coolwarm(range(0, 256, 20))[:len(district_counts)]
bars2 = ax2.bar(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values, color=colors2)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels([k.replace('Kreis ', 'K') for k in district_counts.index], rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.set_xlabel('District')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax2.set_title('Dogs by District', fontweight='bold')

# 3. Dog Age Distribution
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
# Filter out rows with valid dog age and get unique dogs per year
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna() & (df['AlterVHundNum'] <= 20)]
age_counts = age_data['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts()
# Sort by age number
age_order = sorted(age_counts.index, key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if x[0].isdigit() else 0)
age_counts_sorted = age_counts[age_order[:15]]  # Top 15 age groups
ax3.bar(range(len(age_counts_sorted)), age_counts_sorted.values, color='steelblue', edgecolor='navy')
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts_sorted)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(age_counts_sorted.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Dog Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 4. Owner Age vs Dog Gender Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
owner_dog_gender = df.groupby(['AlterV10Lang', 'SexHundLang']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
# Sort by typical age order
age_order_owner = ['0- bis 9-Jährige', '10- bis 19-Jährige', '20- bis 29-Jährige', 
                   '30- bis 39-Jährige', '40- bis 49-Jährige', '50- bis 59-Jährige',
                   '60- bis 69-Jährige', '70- bis 79-Jährige', '80- bis 89-Jährige',
                   '90- bis 99-Jährige']
available_ages = [a for a in age_order_owner if a in owner_dog_gender.index]
owner_dog_gender = owner_dog_gender.loc[available_ages]

x = range(len(owner_dog_gender))
width = 0.35
if 'männlich' in owner_dog_gender.columns:
    ax4.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], owner_dog_gender['männlich'], width, label='Male Dogs', color='#5DA5DA')
if 'weiblich' in owner_dog_gender.columns:
    ax4.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], owner_dog_gender['weiblich'], width, label='Female Dogs', color='#FAA43A')
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels([a.replace('-Jährige', '').replace('- bis ', '-') for a in owner_dog_gender.index], 
                    rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender by Owner Age Group', fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
